name: Gwangju
scopeLimits: The UN WUP 2025 point is a settlement-population locator, not an official city boundary, property identity, or completeness statement. No owner, address, applicant, or tax data was requested or retained; no account credentials, CAPTCHA, or token was used. The anonymous WFS qualification sampled 54 unique nearby polygons in 13 bounded cells. Independent topology review found 53/54 valid and one self-intersecting ring; the three retained sample geometries were individually checked valid. This is local service evidence, not citywide completeness.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The Gwangju Metropolitan City Living Geographic Information Portal exposes the city continuous cadastral (`연속지적도`) layer through an anonymous WFS. Its schema includes PNU and geometry; bounded queries requested only those fields and returned complete multipolygons.

executedQueries.query: Gwangju Metropolitan City South Korea cadastral parcel WFS GIS official map portal
executedQueries.scope: Find the metropolitan city’s official parcel mapping service and public vector route.
executedQueries.result: Search results contained an unrelated Gwangju City in Gyeonggi Province; that portal was excluded. Direct review of the Gwangju Metropolitan City GIS portal and its public WFS exposed the continuous cadastral layer `sde:lsmd_cont_ldreg`; the bounded WFS returned full polygons.
executedQueries.executionMethod: English-language web search followed by anonymous official portal, WFS capabilities/schema and bounded-query inspection.

executedQueries.query: 광주광역시 생활지리정보시스템 지도서비스 지적도 토지정보 공식 광주광역시청
executedQueries.scope: 광주광역시의 공식 지리정보 포털과 연속지적도 공개 서비스를 확인한다.
executedQueries.result: 광주광역시 생활지리정보 포털은 `연속지적도` 레이어를 `sde:lsmd_cont_ldreg` WFS로 공개한다. 익명 제한 조회는 PNU와 전체 MultiPolygon 경계만 반환했다. 경기도 광주시의 동명 포털은 제외했다.
executedQueries.executionMethod: 별도 한국어 웹 검색 후 공식 포털, WFS Capabilities/DescribeFeatureType 및 제한 조회를 검사.

officialSources.observation: Official city GIS portal (not Gwangju-si in Gyeonggi Province). Portal lists parcel/cadastral map functions, including land ledger/map tools; legal disclaimer says map is for reference and may differ from actual/legal records.

officialSources.operator: Gwangju Metropolitan City GIS portal WFS proxy
officialSources.observation: Anonymous WFS 1.1.0 capabilities and schema expose `sde:lsmd_cont_ldreg` (`연속지적`) in EPSG:5186; safe requested attributes were limited to `pnu` plus geometry.

requests.observation: Official portal layer catalogue returned nine thematic layers/groups, including continuous cadastral layer `lsmd_cont_ldreg`.
Official portal lists Gwangju Metropolitan City districts (남구, 동구, 북구, 서구, 광산구).
Anonymous WFS capabilities identify GeoServer layer `sde:lsmd_cont_ldreg`, titled `연속지적`, with EPSG:5186 support.
Schema has sgg_oid, jibun, bchk, pnu and geom; the qualification request allowlist included only pnu and geom.

Unmodified repository adapter qualification queried a 13-cell grid around the exact WUP point, with response in CRS:84 and `propertyName=geom,pnu`. 54 unique MultiPolygon parcels returned; 19 adapter tests passed, including 14-page forced pagination, fresh exact-ID reads for all 54, explicit absence, footprint lookup and source binding. See acceptance report.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Bounded city cadastral sample near the WUP settlement locator; no full-city completeness claim.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Anonymous WFS returned 54 unique parcels in 13 0.001-degree cells; all adapter checks passed. A separate metric topology audit found 53 valid and one ring self-intersection. Three valid samples are retained.

research.technicalBlocker: Not an access blocker. The official map states that it is for reference and may differ from legal records. Independent geometry QA found one self-intersecting ring among the 54 sampled parcels, so the candidate needs parent review before runtime admission.
research.remainingUncertainty: Citywide coverage, cadastral update cadence, and long-term stability of PNU identifiers are not established. The single invalid sample feature may reflect source geometry defects or coordinate/topology encoding.

source.scope: 54 bounded complete source geometries; Independent root GEOS audit in EPSG:32652 reproduces a ring self-intersection in native PNU 1224012100107000001 among 54 complete public source polygons. All 19 protocol checks passed, but runtime remains held without repair or excluding the failing parcel. A native EPSG:5186 follow-up returned HTML maintenance/error content rather than parcel geometry; native-coordinate validity remains unestablished.
